# Sohom-Banerjee
[index.html](https://github.com/user-attachments/files/27267123/index.html)
<!DOCTYPE html>
<html lang="en">
<head>
<meta charset="UTF-8">
<meta name="viewport" content="width=device-width, initial-scale=1.0">
<title>Sohom Banerjee — Portfolio</title>
<link href="https://fonts.googleapis.com/css2?family=Playfair+Display:ital,wght@0,400;0,700;0,900;1,400;1,700&family=Bebas+Neue&family=Cormorant+Garamond:ital,wght@0,300;0,400;0,600;1,300;1,400&family=Space+Mono:wght@400;700&display=swap" rel="stylesheet">
<style>
:root {
  --gold: #c9a96e;
  --gold2: #f0d080;
  --black: #050505;
  --off-black: #0f0f0f;
  --dark: #141414;
  --white: #f5f0e8;
  --cream: #ede8d8;
  --grey: #888880;
  --accent: #e8c56a;
}

*, *::before, *::after { box-sizing: border-box; margin: 0; padding: 0; }

html { scroll-behavior: smooth; }

body {
  background: var(--black);
  color: var(--white);
  font-family: 'Cormorant Garamond', serif;
  overflow-x: hidden;
  cursor: none;
}

/* CUSTOM CURSOR */
.cursor {
  width: 12px; height: 12px;
  background: var(--gold);
  border-radius: 50%;
  position: fixed; top: 0; left: 0;
  pointer-events: none;
  z-index: 9999;
  transform: translate(-50%,-50%);
  transition: transform 0.1s;
  mix-blend-mode: difference;
}
.cursor-ring {
  width: 40px; height: 40px;
  border: 1px solid var(--gold);
  border-radius: 50%;
  position: fixed; top: 0; left: 0;
  pointer-events: none;
  z-index: 9998;
  transform: translate(-50%,-50%);
  transition: all 0.2s ease;
}

/* NOISE OVERLAY */
body::before {
  content: '';
  position: fixed;
  inset: 0;
  background-image: url("data:image/svg+xml,%3Csvg viewBox='0 0 200 200' xmlns='http://www.w3.org/2000/svg'%3E%3Cfilter id='n'%3E%3CfeTurbulence type='fractalNoise' baseFrequency='0.9' numOctaves='4' stitchTiles='stitch'/%3E%3C/filter%3E%3Crect width='100%25' height='100%25' filter='url(%23n)' opacity='0.04'/%3E%3C/svg%3E");
  pointer-events: none;
  z-index: 9990;
  opacity: 0.4;
}

/* SCROLLBAR */
::-webkit-scrollbar { width: 3px; }
::-webkit-scrollbar-track { background: var(--black); }
::-webkit-scrollbar-thumb { background: var(--gold); }

/* NAV */
nav {
  position: fixed; top: 0; left: 0; right: 0;
  z-index: 100;
  display: flex; align-items: center; justify-content: space-between;
  padding: 24px 60px;
  background: linear-gradient(to bottom, rgba(5,5,5,0.95), transparent);
  mix-blend-mode: normal;
}
.nav-logo {
  font-family: 'Playfair Display', serif;
  font-size: 22px; font-weight: 900;
  letter-spacing: 0.05em;
  color: var(--white);
}
.nav-logo span { color: var(--gold); }
.nav-links { display: flex; gap: 40px; list-style: none; }
.nav-links a {
  font-family: 'Space Mono', monospace;
  font-size: 11px; letter-spacing: 0.2em; text-transform: uppercase;
  color: var(--grey); text-decoration: none;
  transition: color 0.3s;
  position: relative;
}
.nav-links a::after {
  content: ''; position: absolute; bottom: -4px; left: 0;
  width: 0; height: 1px; background: var(--gold);
  transition: width 0.3s;
}
.nav-links a:hover { color: var(--gold); }
.nav-links a:hover::after { width: 100%; }

/* ===================== HERO ===================== */
#hero {
  min-height: 100vh;
  display: grid;
  grid-template-columns: 1fr 1fr;
  position: relative;
  overflow: hidden;
}
.hero-left {
  display: flex; flex-direction: column;
  justify-content: center;
  padding: 140px 60px 80px 60px;
  position: relative; z-index: 2;
}
.hero-eyebrow {
  font-family: 'Space Mono', monospace;
  font-size: 10px; letter-spacing: 0.4em; text-transform: uppercase;
  color: var(--gold); margin-bottom: 24px;
  opacity: 0; animation: fadeUp 0.8s 0.2s forwards;
}
.hero-name {
  font-family: 'Bebas Neue', sans-serif;
  font-size: clamp(72px, 9vw, 130px);
  line-height: 0.9;
  letter-spacing: 0.02em;
  color: var(--white);
  opacity: 0; animation: fadeUp 0.8s 0.4s forwards;
}
.hero-name .gold-line { color: var(--gold); display: block; }
.hero-tagline {
  font-family: 'Cormorant Garamond', serif;
  font-style: italic;
  font-size: clamp(18px, 2.2vw, 28px);
  color: var(--cream); margin-top: 28px;
  line-height: 1.5;
  opacity: 0; animation: fadeUp 0.8s 0.6s forwards;
  max-width: 420px;
}
.hero-divider {
  width: 60px; height: 1px; background: var(--gold);
  margin: 32px 0;
  opacity: 0; animation: fadeUp 0.8s 0.8s forwards;
}
.hero-roles {
  display: flex; flex-wrap: wrap; gap: 12px;
  opacity: 0; animation: fadeUp 0.8s 1s forwards;
}
.role-tag {
  font-family: 'Space Mono', monospace;
  font-size: 10px; letter-spacing: 0.15em; text-transform: uppercase;
  border: 1px solid rgba(201,169,110,0.4);
  padding: 8px 16px; color: var(--gold);
  transition: all 0.3s;
}
.role-tag:hover { background: var(--gold); color: var(--black); }

.hero-cta {
  margin-top: 48px;
  opacity: 0; animation: fadeUp 0.8s 1.2s forwards;
}
.btn-primary {
  font-family: 'Space Mono', monospace;
  font-size: 11px; letter-spacing: 0.2em; text-transform: uppercase;
  background: var(--gold); color: var(--black);
  border: none; padding: 16px 36px;
  cursor: pointer; text-decoration: none;
  display: inline-block;
  transition: all 0.3s;
  font-weight: 700;
}
.btn-primary:hover { background: var(--gold2); transform: translateY(-2px); }
.btn-ghost {
  font-family: 'Space Mono', monospace;
  font-size: 11px; letter-spacing: 0.2em; text-transform: uppercase;
  background: transparent; color: var(--white);
  border: 1px solid rgba(255,255,255,0.2); padding: 16px 36px;
  cursor: pointer; text-decoration: none;
  display: inline-block;
  transition: all 0.3s; margin-left: 16px;
}
.btn-ghost:hover { border-color: var(--gold); color: var(--gold); }

.hero-right {
  position: relative; overflow: hidden;
  opacity: 0; animation: fadeIn 1.2s 0.3s forwards;
}
.hero-img-main {
  width: 100%; height: 100%;
  object-fit: cover; object-position: top center;
  filter: contrast(1.05) brightness(0.9);
}
.hero-overlay {
  position: absolute; inset: 0;
  background: linear-gradient(to right, var(--black) 0%, transparent 30%, transparent 70%, rgba(5,5,5,0.3) 100%),
              linear-gradient(to top, var(--black) 0%, transparent 20%);
}
.hero-side-text {
  position: absolute; right: -40px; top: 50%;
  transform: translateY(-50%) rotate(90deg);
  font-family: 'Bebas Neue', sans-serif;
  font-size: 11px; letter-spacing: 0.5em;
  color: rgba(201,169,110,0.3);
}
.hero-number {
  position: absolute; bottom: 40px; right: 40px;
  font-family: 'Bebas Neue', sans-serif;
  font-size: 120px; line-height: 1;
  color: rgba(201,169,110,0.08);
  pointer-events: none;
}
.scroll-indicator {
  position: absolute; bottom: 40px; left: 60px;
  display: flex; align-items: center; gap: 12px;
  font-family: 'Space Mono', monospace;
  font-size: 9px; letter-spacing: 0.3em; text-transform: uppercase;
  color: var(--grey);
  opacity: 0; animation: fadeUp 1s 1.5s forwards;
}
.scroll-line {
  width: 40px; height: 1px; background: var(--grey);
  animation: scrollPulse 2s infinite;
}

/* ===================== ABOUT ===================== */
#about {
  background: var(--off-black);
  padding: 120px 60px;
  position: relative;
  overflow: hidden;
}
#about::before {
  content: 'ABOUT';
  position: absolute; top: 40px; right: 60px;
  font-family: 'Bebas Neue', sans-serif;
  font-size: 180px; color: rgba(255,255,255,0.02);
  letter-spacing: 0.1em; pointer-events: none;
}
.about-grid {
  display: grid;
  grid-template-columns: 1fr 1.4fr;
  gap: 80px; align-items: center;
  max-width: 1300px; margin: 0 auto;
}
.about-img-wrap {
  position: relative;
}
.about-img {
  width: 100%; aspect-ratio: 3/4;
  object-fit: cover; object-position: top;
  filter: grayscale(20%) contrast(1.05);
}
.about-img-frame {
  position: absolute; inset: -12px -12px 12px 12px;
  border: 1px solid rgba(201,169,110,0.3);
  pointer-events: none;
}
.about-img-label {
  position: absolute; bottom: -20px; left: 0;
  font-family: 'Space Mono', monospace;
  font-size: 9px; letter-spacing: 0.3em; text-transform: uppercase;
  color: var(--gold);
}
.section-label {
  font-family: 'Space Mono', monospace;
  font-size: 10px; letter-spacing: 0.4em; text-transform: uppercase;
  color: var(--gold); margin-bottom: 24px;
  display: flex; align-items: center; gap: 16px;
}
.section-label::before {
  content: ''; display: inline-block;
  width: 30px; height: 1px; background: var(--gold);
}
.section-title {
  font-family: 'Playfair Display', serif;
  font-size: clamp(38px, 5vw, 64px);
  line-height: 1.05; font-weight: 900;
  color: var(--white); margin-bottom: 32px;
}
.section-title em { color: var(--gold); font-style: italic; }
.about-text {
  font-size: 18px; line-height: 1.9;
  color: var(--cream); font-weight: 300;
  margin-bottom: 24px;
}
.about-values {
  display: grid; grid-template-columns: 1fr 1fr;
  gap: 20px; margin-top: 40px;
}
.value-item {
  border-left: 2px solid var(--gold);
  padding: 12px 20px;
}
.value-label {
  font-family: 'Space Mono', monospace;
  font-size: 9px; letter-spacing: 0.3em; text-transform: uppercase;
  color: var(--gold); margin-bottom: 6px;
}
.value-text {
  font-family: 'Cormorant Garamond', serif;
  font-size: 16px; color: var(--cream);
}

/* ===================== PASSIONS ===================== */
#passions {
  background: var(--black);
  padding: 120px 60px;
  position: relative; overflow: hidden;
}
.passions-header {
  text-align: center; margin-bottom: 80px;
}
.passions-grid {
  display: grid;
  grid-template-columns: repeat(3, 1fr);
  gap: 2px;
  max-width: 1300px; margin: 0 auto;
}
.passion-card {
  position: relative; overflow: hidden;
  aspect-ratio: 1;
  background: var(--dark);
  cursor: pointer;
  transition: all 0.5s ease;
}
.passion-card::before {
  content: ''; position: absolute; inset: 0;
  background: var(--gold);
  transform: scaleX(0); transform-origin: left;
  transition: transform 0.4s ease; z-index: 0;
}
.passion-card:hover::before { transform: scaleX(1); }
.passion-card:hover .passion-icon { color: var(--black); }
.passion-card:hover .passion-title { color: var(--black); }
.passion-card:hover .passion-desc { color: var(--black); }
.passion-inner {
  position: relative; z-index: 1;
  padding: 48px 40px; height: 100%;
  display: flex; flex-direction: column; justify-content: flex-end;
}
.passion-icon {
  font-size: 48px; margin-bottom: auto;
  display: block; padding-top: 20px;
  transition: color 0.4s;
}
.passion-title {
  font-family: 'Bebas Neue', sans-serif;
  font-size: 36px; letter-spacing: 0.05em;
  color: var(--white); margin-bottom: 12px;
  transition: color 0.4s; line-height: 1;
}
.passion-desc {
  font-family: 'Cormorant Garamond', serif;
  font-size: 15px; color: var(--grey); line-height: 1.6;
  transition: color 0.4s;
}
.passion-card.featured {
  grid-column: span 2; aspect-ratio: auto; min-height: 300px;
}

/* ===================== EXPERIENCE ===================== */
#experience {
  background: var(--off-black);
  padding: 120px 60px;
  position: relative; overflow: hidden;
}
#experience::before {
  content: 'WORK';
  position: absolute; top: 20px; left: 60px;
  font-family: 'Bebas Neue', sans-serif;
  font-size: 200px; color: rgba(255,255,255,0.015);
  letter-spacing: 0.1em; pointer-events: none;
}
.exp-layout {
  display: grid;
  grid-template-columns: 300px 1fr;
  gap: 80px;
  max-width: 1300px; margin: 0 auto;
}
.exp-sidebar {
  position: sticky; top: 120px; align-self: start;
}
.exp-timeline { display: flex; flex-direction: column; gap: 0; }
.exp-item {
  border-left: 1px solid rgba(201,169,110,0.2);
  padding: 40px 0 40px 40px;
  position: relative;
  transition: all 0.3s;
}
.exp-item::before {
  content: ''; position: absolute; left: -5px; top: 44px;
  width: 9px; height: 9px; background: var(--off-black);
  border: 1px solid var(--gold); border-radius: 50%;
  transition: background 0.3s;
}
.exp-item:hover::before { background: var(--gold); }
.exp-item:hover { border-left-color: var(--gold); }
.exp-year {
  font-family: 'Space Mono', monospace;
  font-size: 10px; letter-spacing: 0.2em; text-transform: uppercase;
  color: var(--gold); margin-bottom: 10px;
}
.exp-company {
  font-family: 'Playfair Display', serif;
  font-size: 22px; font-weight: 700;
  color: var(--white); margin-bottom: 6px;
}
.exp-role {
  font-family: 'Cormorant Garamond', serif;
  font-size: 15px; color: var(--grey); margin-bottom: 20px;
  font-style: italic;
}
.exp-grade {
  display: inline-block;
  font-family: 'Space Mono', monospace;
  font-size: 9px; letter-spacing: 0.2em; text-transform: uppercase;
  background: var(--gold); color: var(--black);
  padding: 4px 12px; margin-bottom: 20px;
}
.exp-bullets { list-style: none; }
.exp-bullets li {
  font-size: 16px; color: var(--cream); line-height: 1.7;
  padding: 8px 0; border-bottom: 1px solid rgba(255,255,255,0.04);
  padding-left: 16px; position: relative;
}
.exp-bullets li::before {
  content: '→'; position: absolute; left: 0;
  color: var(--gold); font-size: 12px; top: 10px;
}

/* ===================== SKILLS ===================== */
#skills {
  background: var(--dark);
  padding: 120px 60px;
}
.skills-layout {
  display: grid;
  grid-template-columns: 1fr 1fr;
  gap: 80px; align-items: start;
  max-width: 1300px; margin: 0 auto;
}
.skills-visual { position: relative; }
.skill-bars { display: flex; flex-direction: column; gap: 28px; }
.skill-row { }
.skill-head {
  display: flex; justify-content: space-between;
  margin-bottom: 10px;
}
.skill-name {
  font-family: 'Cormorant Garamond', serif;
  font-size: 17px; color: var(--white); letter-spacing: 0.05em;
}
.skill-pct {
  font-family: 'Space Mono', monospace;
  font-size: 11px; color: var(--gold);
}
.skill-bar-bg {
  height: 2px; background: rgba(255,255,255,0.08);
  position: relative; overflow: hidden;
}
.skill-bar-fill {
  height: 100%; background: linear-gradient(to right, var(--gold), var(--gold2));
  transform: scaleX(0); transform-origin: left;
  animation: fillBar 1.5s ease forwards;
  animation-play-state: paused;
}
.skill-bar-fill.animate { animation-play-state: running; }
.certs-grid {
  display: grid; grid-template-columns: 1fr 1fr;
  gap: 16px;
}
.cert-card {
  background: rgba(255,255,255,0.03);
  border: 1px solid rgba(201,169,110,0.15);
  padding: 20px;
  transition: all 0.3s;
}
.cert-card:hover {
  border-color: var(--gold);
  background: rgba(201,169,110,0.05);
  transform: translateY(-4px);
}
.cert-issuer {
  font-family: 'Space Mono', monospace;
  font-size: 9px; letter-spacing: 0.3em; text-transform: uppercase;
  color: var(--gold); margin-bottom: 8px;
}
.cert-name {
  font-family: 'Cormorant Garamond', serif;
  font-size: 15px; color: var(--white); line-height: 1.4;
}

/* ===================== MAGAZINE SPREAD ===================== */
#magazine {
  position: relative; overflow: hidden;
  min-height: 80vh;
  display: grid; grid-template-columns: 1fr 1fr;
}
.mag-left {
  position: relative; overflow: hidden;
}
.mag-img {
  width: 100%; height: 100%;
  object-fit: cover; object-position: top;
}
.mag-right {
  background: var(--off-black);
  padding: 80px 60px;
  display: flex; flex-direction: column;
  justify-content: center;
}
.mag-quote {
  font-family: 'Playfair Display', serif;
  font-size: clamp(28px, 4vw, 52px);
  font-style: italic; line-height: 1.3;
  color: var(--white); margin-bottom: 32px;
}
.mag-quote em { color: var(--gold); }
.mag-author {
  font-family: 'Space Mono', monospace;
  font-size: 10px; letter-spacing: 0.3em; text-transform: uppercase;
  color: var(--gold);
}
.mag-stats {
  display: grid; grid-template-columns: 1fr 1fr;
  gap: 32px; margin-top: 60px;
}
.stat-num {
  font-family: 'Bebas Neue', sans-serif;
  font-size: 72px; color: var(--gold);
  line-height: 1;
}
.stat-label {
  font-family: 'Cormorant Garamond', serif;
  font-size: 15px; color: var(--grey); margin-top: 4px;
}

/* ===================== IDENTITY ===================== */
#identity {
  background: var(--gold);
  padding: 100px 60px;
  position: relative; overflow: hidden;
}
#identity::before {
  content: 'BRAND';
  position: absolute; top: -20px; right: 40px;
  font-family: 'Bebas Neue', sans-serif;
  font-size: 200px; color: rgba(0,0,0,0.06);
  letter-spacing: 0.1em; pointer-events: none;
}
.identity-inner {
  max-width: 900px; margin: 0 auto; text-align: center;
}
.identity-title {
  font-family: 'Bebas Neue', sans-serif;
  font-size: clamp(60px, 10vw, 120px);
  color: var(--black); line-height: 0.9;
  letter-spacing: 0.02em; margin-bottom: 32px;
}
.identity-sub {
  font-family: 'Cormorant Garamond', serif;
  font-size: 22px; font-style: italic;
  color: var(--dark); margin-bottom: 48px;
  line-height: 1.7;
}
.identity-pillars {
  display: flex; justify-content: center; gap: 60px;
  flex-wrap: wrap;
}
.pillar {
  text-align: center;
}
.pillar-word {
  font-family: 'Bebas Neue', sans-serif;
  font-size: 32px; letter-spacing: 0.1em;
  color: var(--black);
}
.pillar-dot {
  width: 6px; height: 6px; background: var(--black);
  border-radius: 50%; margin: 10px auto;
}

/* ===================== SOUL ===================== */
#soul {
  background: var(--black);
  padding: 120px 60px;
  position: relative; overflow: hidden;
}
.soul-layout {
  display: grid;
  grid-template-columns: 1fr 1fr;
  gap: 80px;
  max-width: 1300px; margin: 0 auto;
}
.soul-card {
  background: rgba(255,255,255,0.02);
  border: 1px solid rgba(201,169,110,0.1);
  padding: 48px 40px;
  position: relative; overflow: hidden;
  transition: all 0.4s;
}
.soul-card::after {
  content: ''; position: absolute; bottom: 0; left: 0; right: 0;
  height: 2px; background: var(--gold);
  transform: scaleX(0); transform-origin: left;
  transition: transform 0.4s;
}
.soul-card:hover { border-color: rgba(201,169,110,0.3); transform: translateY(-8px); }
.soul-card:hover::after { transform: scaleX(1); }
.soul-emoji { font-size: 40px; margin-bottom: 20px; display: block; }
.soul-title {
  font-family: 'Playfair Display', serif;
  font-size: 28px; font-weight: 700;
  color: var(--white); margin-bottom: 16px;
}
.soul-text {
  font-family: 'Cormorant Garamond', serif;
  font-size: 17px; color: var(--grey); line-height: 1.8;
}
.soul-text em { color: var(--gold); font-style: italic; }

/* ===================== PROJECTS / EDUCATION ===================== */
#projects {
  background: var(--off-black);
  padding: 120px 60px;
}
.projects-grid {
  display: grid;
  grid-template-columns: repeat(3, 1fr);
  gap: 24px;
  max-width: 1300px; margin: 0 auto;
}
.project-card {
  background: var(--dark);
  border: 1px solid rgba(255,255,255,0.04);
  padding: 40px 32px;
  position: relative; overflow: hidden;
  transition: all 0.4s; cursor: pointer;
}
.project-card::before {
  content: '';
  position: absolute; top: 0; left: 0; right: 0;
  height: 3px; background: linear-gradient(to right, var(--gold), var(--gold2));
  transform: scaleX(0); transform-origin: left;
  transition: transform 0.4s;
}
.project-card:hover { transform: translateY(-8px); border-color: rgba(201,169,110,0.2); }
.project-card:hover::before { transform: scaleX(1); }
.project-num {
  font-family: 'Bebas Neue', sans-serif;
  font-size: 64px; color: rgba(201,169,110,0.1);
  line-height: 1; margin-bottom: 16px;
}
.project-type {
  font-family: 'Space Mono', monospace;
  font-size: 9px; letter-spacing: 0.3em; text-transform: uppercase;
  color: var(--gold); margin-bottom: 12px;
}
.project-title {
  font-family: 'Playfair Display', serif;
  font-size: 22px; font-weight: 700;
  color: var(--white); margin-bottom: 16px; line-height: 1.3;
}
.project-desc {
  font-family: 'Cormorant Garamond', serif;
  font-size: 16px; color: var(--grey); line-height: 1.7;
}

/* ===================== TRAVEL ===================== */
#travel {
  background: var(--black);
  padding: 120px 60px;
  position: relative; overflow: hidden;
}
.travel-marquee-wrap {
  overflow: hidden; margin: 60px 0;
  border-top: 1px solid rgba(201,169,110,0.2);
  border-bottom: 1px solid rgba(201,169,110,0.2);
  padding: 20px 0;
}
.travel-marquee {
  display: flex; gap: 60px;
  animation: marquee 20s linear infinite;
  white-space: nowrap;
}
.travel-marquee span {
  font-family: 'Bebas Neue', sans-serif;
  font-size: 32px; letter-spacing: 0.1em;
  color: rgba(201,169,110,0.3);
}
.travel-marquee span.bright { color: var(--gold); }
.travel-content {
  max-width: 1300px; margin: 0 auto;
  display: grid; grid-template-columns: 1.2fr 1fr;
  gap: 80px; align-items: center;
}
.travel-text { }
.travel-destinations {
  display: grid; grid-template-columns: 1fr 1fr;
  gap: 16px;
}
.dest-item {
  border: 1px solid rgba(201,169,110,0.1);
  padding: 20px;
  font-family: 'Cormorant Garamond', serif;
  transition: all 0.3s;
}
.dest-item:hover { border-color: var(--gold); background: rgba(201,169,110,0.03); }
.dest-country {
  font-family: 'Space Mono', monospace;
  font-size: 9px; letter-spacing: 0.2em; text-transform: uppercase;
  color: var(--gold); margin-bottom: 4px;
}
.dest-city { font-size: 18px; color: var(--white); }

/* ===================== SIGNATURE / FOOTER ===================== */
#contact {
  background: var(--off-black);
  padding: 120px 60px 80px;
  position: relative; overflow: hidden;
}
.contact-layout {
  max-width: 1300px; margin: 0 auto;
  display: grid; grid-template-columns: 1fr 1fr;
  gap: 80px; align-items: end;
}
.contact-left { }
.contact-big {
  font-family: 'Bebas Neue', sans-serif;
  font-size: clamp(60px, 8vw, 110px);
  line-height: 0.9;
  color: var(--white); margin-bottom: 40px;
}
.contact-big span { color: var(--gold); }
.contact-info { display: flex; flex-direction: column; gap: 20px; }
.contact-item {
  display: flex; gap: 20px; align-items: center;
}
.contact-label {
  font-family: 'Space Mono', monospace;
  font-size: 9px; letter-spacing: 0.3em; text-transform: uppercase;
  color: var(--gold); min-width: 80px;
}
.contact-value {
  font-family: 'Cormorant Garamond', serif;
  font-size: 18px; color: var(--cream);
  text-decoration: none;
  transition: color 0.3s;
}
.contact-value:hover { color: var(--gold); }

.signature-wrap {
  text-align: right;
  display: flex; flex-direction: column;
  align-items: flex-end; gap: 24px;
}
.signature {
  font-family: 'Playfair Display', serif;
  font-style: italic; font-weight: 700;
  font-size: clamp(72px, 10vw, 130px);
  color: var(--gold);
  line-height: 1;
  text-shadow: 0 0 60px rgba(201,169,110,0.3);
  letter-spacing: -0.02em;
}
.signature-under {
  font-family: 'Space Mono', monospace;
  font-size: 10px; letter-spacing: 0.4em;
  text-transform: uppercase; color: var(--grey);
}
.signature-line {
  width: 100%; height: 1px;
  background: linear-gradient(to right, transparent, var(--gold), transparent);
}

footer {
  background: var(--black);
  padding: 32px 60px;
  display: flex; justify-content: space-between; align-items: center;
  border-top: 1px solid rgba(255,255,255,0.04);
}
.footer-copy {
  font-family: 'Space Mono', monospace;
  font-size: 10px; letter-spacing: 0.15em;
  color: var(--grey);
}
.footer-sig {
  font-family: 'Playfair Display', serif;
  font-style: italic; font-size: 20px;
  color: var(--gold);
}

/* ===================== ANIMATIONS ===================== */
@keyframes fadeUp {
  from { opacity: 0; transform: translateY(30px); }
  to { opacity: 1; transform: translateY(0); }
}
@keyframes fadeIn {
  from { opacity: 0; } to { opacity: 1; }
}
@keyframes fillBar {
  from { transform: scaleX(0); } to { transform: scaleX(1); }
}
@keyframes marquee {
  from { transform: translateX(0); }
  to { transform: translateX(-50%); }
}
@keyframes scrollPulse {
  0%, 100% { opacity: 0.4; } 50% { opacity: 1; }
}
@keyframes float {
  0%, 100% { transform: translateY(0); }
  50% { transform: translateY(-10px); }
}

/* SCROLL REVEAL */
.reveal {
  opacity: 0; transform: translateY(40px);
  transition: opacity 0.8s ease, transform 0.8s ease;
}
.reveal.visible { opacity: 1; transform: translateY(0); }
.reveal-delay-1 { transition-delay: 0.1s; }
.reveal-delay-2 { transition-delay: 0.2s; }
.reveal-delay-3 { transition-delay: 0.3s; }
.reveal-delay-4 { transition-delay: 0.4s; }
</style>
</head>

<script>
// Inject base64 images
document.getElementById('heroImg').src = 'data:image/jpeg;base64,';
document.getElementById('aboutImg').src = 'data:image/jpeg;base64,';
document.getElementById('magImg').src = 'data:image/jpeg;base64,';

// Custom cursor
const cursor = document.getElementById('cursor');
const ring = document.getElementById('cursorRing');
document.addEventListener('mousemove', e => {
  cursor.style.left = e.clientX + 'px';
  cursor.style.top = e.clientY + 'px';
  setTimeout(() => {
    ring.style.left = e.clientX + 'px';
    ring.style.top = e.clientY + 'px';
  }, 80);
});

// Scroll reveal
const reveals = document.querySelectorAll('.reveal');
const observer = new IntersectionObserver(entries => {
  entries.forEach(e => {
    if (e.isIntersecting) {
      e.target.classList.add('visible');
      // Animate skill bars
      const bars = e.target.querySelectorAll('.skill-bar-fill');
      bars.forEach(b => b.classList.add('animate'));
    }
  });
}, { threshold: 0.1 });
reveals.forEach(r => observer.observe(r));

// Skill bar animation via CSS custom property
document.querySelectorAll('.skill-bar-fill').forEach(bar => {
  const w = bar.style.getPropertyValue('--w') || bar.style['--w'];
  bar.style.animationDuration = '1.5s';
  // We use transform scaleX, controlled by a data attribute approach
  bar.style.setProperty('--target-w', w);
});

// Observe skill bars
const skillObserver = new IntersectionObserver(entries => {
  entries.forEach(e => {
    if (e.isIntersecting) {
      e.target.querySelectorAll('.skill-bar-fill').forEach(b => {
        const pct = parseFloat(b.style.getPropertyValue('--w') || '0.8');
        b.style.transform = 'scaleX(' + pct + ')';
        b.style.transition = 'transform 1.6s cubic-bezier(0.4,0,0.2,1) 0.3s';
      });
    }
  });
}, { threshold: 0.2 });
document.querySelectorAll('.skill-bars').forEach(s => skillObserver.observe(s));

// Smooth nav
document.querySelectorAll('a[href^="#"]').forEach(a => {
  a.addEventListener('click', e => {
    e.preventDefault();
    document.querySelector(a.getAttribute('href')).scrollIntoView({ behavior: 'smooth' });
  });
});
</script>
